newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - July 10.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - July 10.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said it had one large one-day net miss in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The miss occured on Wednesday, causing there to be fewer reserves in the banking system due to the pool of foreign central bank investments at the New York Fed being higher than anticipated.
The high in natural float was about $1.5 billion on Wednesday, while the low in natural float was about $480 million on Monday.
Transportation float averaged about $650 million per day with the high on Wednesday at about $480 million primarily due to weather problems in Ohio, Kentucky and West Virginia.
